START STATE AND BLOCKING

SHOT 04A | 00s to 04s | 4 seconds
28mm medium-wide from south. Guards release the brothers just inside the room and both exit through the rear door. Garmayil closes it after the second guard. Armayil keeps his hands open and low as the brothers recoil toward the left wall.
SHOT 04B | 04s to 08s | 4 seconds
50mm close group view from south-west, still on the south side of the axis. Armayil at right raises one finger briefly near his own mask to request quiet, then lowers both hands openly. Garmayil, behind him near the door, gives a small reassuring nod. Older’s shoulders begin to release; Younger watches his brother.
SHOT 04C | 08s to 15s | 7 seconds
40mm intimate two-shot from south. Older left, Younger right. Older takes Younger by both upper arms, looks into his mask, and draws him into a short relieved embrace. Older’s chest opens and a breath almost becomes a quiet laugh. Younger cautiously returns the embrace. Hold the relief in real time. Armayil’s open hand stays at the far-right edge. Garmayil quietly moves to the right work counter off-screen.
END STATE AND EDIT
Both brothers believe rescue is for both of them. Older is visibly more hopeful. Garmayil is by the right counter; no escape garment is visible yet.
SOUND

NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.
